talks.title: Dark patterns without the hype
talks.speaker: Ana Silva
talks.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached dark patterns over the past year. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. We expect around 88 attendees.

talks.title: A practical guide to cost-aware warehousing
talks.speaker: Kemi Okafor
talks.abstract: Why cost-aware warehousing is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Last year a similar session drew roughly 62 people.
